item.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
item.description: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: ‘GTA VI’ release has swept PlayStation 5 off the shelves worldwide
item.description: The highly anticipated game landed in an already strained market, where console manufacturers have been hit hard by a global memory chip shortage. Fuente: The Washington Post - World.
item.dc:creator: Mary Ilyushina

item.title: Estonia will close border with Russia 'to secure Europe,' foreign minister says during Baku visit
item.description: Estonia has opened its embassies in Baku and Yerevan to strengthen its strategic ties with the South Caucasus. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna confirmed during his visit to the Azerbaijani capital that the Baltic state will close its border with Russia on 1 December. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: "Ni EE.UU. llegó tan lejos": por qué Costa Rica le impidió la entrada al país a Francesca Albanese, relatora especial de la ONU sobre los territorios palestinos
item.description: Albanese había sido invitada al país para recibir este viernes un doctorado honoris causa por la Universidad de Costa Rica, desde donde dijeron que "lamentan profundamente esta situación". Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: Relatives say jailed Iranian twins beaten and tortured, one faces execution
item.description: Taraneh, 21, had been held in enforced disappearance for more than three months and tortured into a confession, according to rights groups. She was sentenced to death and her twin Rumina to 25 years in prison after their arrest in Isfahan on 24 January. Both were shortlisted for the Sakharov Prize. Fuente: Euronews.

item.description: Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Sculpture workshops to create more Indigenous public art
item.description: Renowned Australian bronze-caster Mal Wood wants more Aboriginal art in public places. His sculpture program, travelling through Central Australia and the Barkly, is helping to make that happen. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Elsie Lange

item.title: The eight books our critics couldn't put down in November
item.description: This month's best books include the latest from Solvej Balle, Claire North, Hannah Goldstein and more. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: From $24.6 billion to $1.7 billion: Billionaire Carl Icahn loses 93% of his fortune in five years
item.description: Billionaire Carl Icahn's fortune has fallen from $24.6 billion to about $1.7 billion in five years, even as major US stock indexes surged. Mounting debt, losses on market bets and a looming $1.4 billion bond repayment have put fresh pressure on the veteran investor's business empire, marking a dramatic reversal for one of Wall Street's most feared dealmakers. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Danon demands public correction from UN aid chief over Gaza tent deliveries
item.description: Israel’s UN ambassador demanded a formal apology from Tom Fletcher over his BBC remarks, citing nearly 65,000 additional tents cleared for entry into Gaza. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
item.dc:creator: BY IDAN KWELLER

item.title: 'Antichrist' tradie breaks cult's 27-year code of silence
item.description: For the first time, a devotee of Australia's biggest cult export has revealed the secret tricks its predatory leader uses. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Josh Robertson and Annika Blau

item.title: Chris Bowen may have flamed out at COP, but at least he tried
item.description: The climate talks in Türkiye ended with disappointment for just about everyone, but getting consensus on the global stage is becoming increasingly impossible. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Greber

item.title: Mexico files complaint with US over DEA tip line on alleged drug dealers
item.description: Tensions rise over DEA tip line, with Mexico emphasising respect for its sovereignty amidst growing bilateral discord. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Canal+ targets half of African TV households as it expands local content production
item.description: With competition from international streaming platforms intensifying, Canal+ is betting that locally produced stories, accessible distribution and investment in African creative talent will help secure its position in the continent's rapidly evolving media market. Fuente: Africanews.
item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com

item.title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town after army chief's threat sparks row
item.description: Uganda's army on Friday said it planned to withdraw from the eastern DR Congo town of Lubero in North Kivu. The announcement came days after Ugandan army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba – son of President Yoweri Museveni – threatened to take control of Walikale, another North Kivu town, sparking a diplomatic spat between the two neighbouring nations. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Pennsylvania widow keeps $6,000 home after court rejects stepchildren's inheritance claim
item.description: Jane L. Shellhammer, a widow from Pennsylvania, has successfully defended her right to remain in her family home following her husband's passing. Although his children attempted to lay claim to the property, the Pennsylvania Superior Court determined that the couple owned the house as tenants by the entirety. Consequently, Jane retains sole ownership of the Palmerton residence, a place she has cherished for over 45 years. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Spanish Police Find a Vast Marijuana Bunker Beneath a Backyard Playground
item.description: Five people were arrested in southern Spain after a large marijuana farm was found under a playhouse on artificial turf. Fuente: The New York Times - World.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Wolfe

item.title: In 1947, architect John Lautner designed a Hollywood Hills home with a roof supported by a three-point steel structure; the preserved two-bedroom Polin House is now listed for $2.85 million
item.description: Renowned architect John Lautner's striking house from 1947 has hit the market, offering a distinctive two-bedroom, two-bathroom experience in the vibrant Hollywood Hills. Spanning 1,342 square feet and priced at $2,850,000, this home features a groundbreaking steel roof truss design that provides an uninterrupted interior space. With outdoor terraces enhancing the living area, this listing is a rare chance to own a piece of architectural history. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mecca pact allies condemn ‘heinous’ Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Officials from Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye pledge to protect the kingdom's security during talks in Islamabad. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Why India’s captain wants saliva back in cricket
item.description: India captain Shubman Gill wants cricket’s Covid-era saliva ban relaxed after a five-day Test in Wellington. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Spain races to stop oil spill after ship capsizes off Ibiza
item.description: Spanish authorities raced to contain any damage to ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters on Thursday after a tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized off Ibiza, leaving one dead. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: UK man jailed for online blackmail of vulnerable girls around the world
item.description: Beau-Jack Mensforth, 20, part of a group known as the Com, coerced girls into self-harm, making indecent images of themselves and physically harming pets The Com: the global cybercrime network posing a ‘chilling threat’ to children A 20-year-old man from north-east England has been jailed for blackmailing vulnerable girls around the world, prompting a senior police officer to urge parents to regularly check their children’s devices. Beau-Jack Mensforth admitted 17 offences of making and distributing indecent photographs of children, blackmail, and participating in the activities of an… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Mark Brown North of England correspondent

item.title: Google told to halt Belgium datacentre construction over lack of planning permit
item.description: Greenpeace publishes report showing tech firm is continuing to build despite planning appeal still unresolved Belgian authorities have ordered Google to halt construction work on a large datacentre in the south of the country because the US tech firm’s requests to modify the original terms of the planning permission did not have approval. “Inspectors visited the site and observed that the building was almost finished, with the structural work completed, even though the permit had been refused,” Raphaël Stokis, a Wallonia regional official, told the public broadcaster RTBF . Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Video shows Levski fan caught giving Nazi salute before Marseille match
item.description: Violent clashes marred Marseille’s Europa League win over Levski Sofia, with a filmed Nazi salute, flares, injuries and condemnation from both presidents. Publicado también por: Euronews. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: From cyberbullying to extremist content, can EU Kids Act protect minors online?
item.description: Almost every European teenager is online. Some 96 percent of 15-year-olds use social media, yet many say they do not feel safe there. One in four children in the EU, aged 12 to 17, report having experienced cyberbullying, and nearly one in three say social media has left them feeling stressed, sad or socially excluded. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Elon Musk wants to move AI data centres into space, where near-constant sunlight could help power them. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
item.description: Closely watched decision exposes tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights Canada’s top court has largely upheld a controversial secularism law in the province of Quebec barring public sector workers from wearing conspicuous religious symbols, in a closely watched decision that exposes the tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights. In a 6-1 ruling released on Friday morning , the supreme court found Quebec was permitted to shield the law, Bill 21, from most court challenges on the grounds that it violated… Publicado también por: The Guardian - World, Al Jazeera English. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Divisions deepen between EU member states after tense budget summit
item.description: An EU leaders summit on the bloc's seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine. The budget proposal also includes a 3% tax on US tech companies, in a bid for the EU to generate additional funds. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: Jared Kushner’s 70-minute interview reveals perils of treating Putin like a corporate rival
item.description: Trump’s son-in-law and senior negotiator paints Russian invasion of Ukraine as a misunderstanding to be resolved In the space of a 70-minute interview, Jared Kushner – Donald Trump’s son-in-law and a prominent US negotiator in Russia, Gaza and Iran – probably did more to reveal why the world is mired in entrenched conflicts than a thousand geopolitical tomes or seminars. During the conversation this week with Mathias Döpfner, the chief executive of the Axel Springer media publisher, Kushner gave a rare insight into his diplomatic technique, offering a string of homilies that veered close to… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Wintour Diplomatic editor

item.title: Syria debates citizenship rights for children of foreign fighters
item.description: Syria may amend its nationality law to grant citizenship to children of Syrian mothers and foreign fighters. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Agua del mar Rojo para Jordania: un plan de 6.700 millones de dólares
item.description: Jordania es uno de los países con menos agua del mundo y busca la solución en el mar Rojo. En Áqaba se construye una gran desalinizadora que costará 6.700 millones de dólares y que, desde 2030, debería cubrir el 40% del agua potable de uso doméstico del país. El agua tendrá que recorrer cientos de kilómetros hasta Amán. ¿Puede este proyecto resolver la crisis hídrica jordana y a qué coste? Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: María Clara Calle Aguirre

item.title: More than 57,000 granted UK permanent residence via BN(O) route in year to September
item.description: More than 57,000 arrivals from Hong Kong became permanent residents in the United Kingdom in the 12 months to September 2026 under the bespoke BN(O) immigration pathway launched five years ago, with the city ranking second behind India in the number of UK settlement grants during the period. According to the UK Home Office, 57,040 people were granted permanent residence via the BN(O) route in the 12 months to September 30, 2026. This was up from just 637 BN(O) grants in the preceding 12 months... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Cannix Yau

item.title: DR Congo: Copper reserves put Africa at the centre of the global race for critical minerals
item.description: Africa is emerging as a key player in the global race for copper, accounting for around 10 per cent of the world's estimated reserves. The Democratic Republic of Congo is at the centre of this growing interest, having mined 3.4 million metric tons of copper in 2025. Its vast mineral resources are attracting growing attention from countries and companies around the world, as demand for the metal rises due to its importance in energy infrastructure, electric vehicles and the global transition to cleaner energy. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: French student protests: A 'very bizarre' government response
item.description: “The government had a very bizarre way of dealing with the student protests,” says Jean-Rémi Girard, a secondary school teacher and union representative in Asnières-sur-Seine. He explains how teachers sought to defuse tensions by listening to students, and respecting their right to protest, while keeping classes running. He recounts a police intervention last October and the case of a student facing trial for defending a classmate, and has the full support of several teachers. Girard questions the government's heavy-handed policing and largely symbolic proposals on class sizes and university… Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Kushner calls Gaza rebuilding ‘act of kindness’
item.description: As Gaza remains under Israeli bombardment, US envoy Jared Kushner calls its reconstruction a ‘huge act of kindness'. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: British Gas owner seeks urgent government talks over future of storage facility
item.description: Centrica boss memo to 400 workers at gas plant off Yorkshire coast says utility doing all it can ‘to save your jobs’ The boss of the British Gas owner Centrica has told hundreds of staff at its largest gas storage facility that he was seeking urgent talks with Andy Burnham and would do everything he could to save jobs. Chris O’Shea, the chief executive of Centrica, reportedly told staff at the Rough gas storage facility off the east Yorkshire that the government had rebuffed the company’s plea for short-term support to run the store over the winter. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Jillian Ambrose

item.title: León XIV, en su viaje de regreso a Roma: «El mensaje que yo quiero dar no es político. Aunque quieran forzarme a derecha e izquierda»
item.description: El Papa ha respondido pletórico a las preguntas de la prensa durante el vuelo de regreso de Perú . A lo largo de veinticinco minutos ha presumido entre bromas de su buena salud, ha ironizado sobre el rosario de un peregrino que le golpeó la cara en Lima y ha asegurado que no ha dejado escrita su renuncia para el caso de incapacidad . Con tono más serio ha alertado de los algoritmos que polarizan «intencionadamente» a las personas y ha lamentado que intentan apropiarse políticamente de él «a derecha e izquierda» .El avión papal, un Boeing 787 de la compañía chilena y brasileña Latam, ha… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Javier Martínez-Brocal

item.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
item.description: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Back to Black Friday: 'We are now bombarded with offers throughout the year'
item.description: Black Friday was once a single day of holiday sales, held the day after Thanksgiving. Then retailers began kicking things off a day early, on Thanksgiving itself. “We are now bombarded with offers throughout the year,” says Hilary Ingham, Professor of Economics and Department Head at Lancaster University, who has no plans to shop this Black Friday. Ingham acknowledges a growing sense of “retail fatigue” but still sees the potential for a peak in sales. Meanwhile, an investigation by The Telegraph suggests that six in ten of the most popular products were actually more expensive than earlier… Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Is stubble burning in Punjab affecting Sri Lanka’s air quality?
item.description: Pollution from northern India and the wider region travels over the Bay of Bengal to Sri Lanka during the northeast monsoon, and crop burning is part of that mix Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong
item.description: The tiny Vallarta mud turtle was only discovered in 2018. It's critically endangered with around 300 thought to live in the wild. Almost one tenth of that number were stashed in a traveler's luggage, bound in duct tape. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: New Zealand Earthship built from 1,300 tyres and 7,000 bottles goes on sale after TV fame
item.description: For sale in New Zealand's scenic Coromandel region, a distinct four-bedroom Earthship home composed of recycled tyres and glass bottles awaits new owners. This eco-conscious abode, featuring solar power and passive heating, was constructed in 2015 and has gained popularity following its showcase on Grand Designs New Zealand. Owners Gus Anning and Sarah Rowe are transitioning to the Bay of Islands, seeking individuals who will honor their sustainable dream. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Directo París y los choques violentos entre hinchas del Marsella y el Levski Sofía
item.description: La victoria del Olympique de Marsella sobre Levski Sofía en la Europa League quedó opacada por graves incidentes entre aficionados en el estadio Vélodrome. Los enfrentamientos dejaron hinchas heridos e incluso hospitalizados, y han provocado una investigación de las autoridades francesas y la atención de la UEFA. Según testimonios y videos difundidos, la violencia estalló tras provocaciones entre grupos de hinchas, incluidas acusaciones de saludos nazis. El informe es de nuestra periodista Natalia Ruiz. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: "Usted, calladita": la agresiva frase de Feijóo a Colau que impactó en la recta final de la campaña electoral en España
item.description: El líder del Partido Popular cruzó a la dirigente progresista del Frente Amplio en medio del debate. El tenso ida y vuelta en el que también participó Pedro Sánchez. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.title: By Putin's logic, Russia should be returned to Mongolia, Belarus' Lukashenka says
item.description: The Belarusian leader said medieval history cannot justify territorial claims, since Russian lands were themselves once under Mongol rule, and traced East Slavic statehood to Kyivan Rus'. He then appeared to soften the remarks, saying Putin "perfectly understands this" and is "misinterpreted". Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: UK DWP takes online services offline after cyber incident, but benefit payments continue
item.description: On November 27, 2026, a significant cyber incident struck the UK's Department for Work and Pensions, leading to the suspension of online services for Universal Credit and other benefits as a precautionary measure. Although regular payments remained unaffected, users faced difficulties accessing their accounts and processing applications. Cybersecurity professionals cautioned about potential scams aimed at those caught up in this disruption. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: France’s Bookstores, Beloved Curators of Literature, Are in a Deep Crisis
item.description: Caught between by rising costs and price regulations, French booksellers are closing at a record pace, depriving new authors of vital shelf space. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: Serbia’s student-led movement nominates chemistry professor for presidency
item.description: Radomir Saicic, who teaches at Belgrade University, was among the first university professors to join the movement. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: China and Belt and Road partners step up cooperation on green energy
item.description: Energy cooperation is taking centre stage as Belt and Road countries push for a greener, more secure global energy future. Ministers wrapped up the Fourth Belt and Road Energy Ministerial Conference in Qingdao, eastern China. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Códice Azcatitlán vuelve a México tras 186 años en París
item.description: Tras 186 años en París, el Códice Azcatitlán vuelve temporalmente a México. Francia y México celebran el bicentenario de sus relaciones diplomáticas con el préstamo de este manuscrito, uno de los grandes testimonios de la historia mexica. El gesto abre una nueva etapa en un vínculo que quiere dejar atrás las crisis diplomáticas del pasado y apostar por una ambiciosa agenda económica y científica. ¿Qué cuenta el códice y por qué este regreso es tan simbólico? Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Florencia Valdés

item.title: Climate Talks Imploded, but the ‘Age of Electricity’ Rolls On, Energy Chief Says
item.description: Fatih Birol, head of the International Energy Agency, said that market forces, data centers and energy security are driving the clean transition anyway. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: Russian drone strikes hit Ukraine's energy, rail and civilian infrastructure, causing deaths
item.description: After a series of Russian strikes and with the onset of winter cold, Ukraine was forced to halt all electricity exports, while imports reached their highest level since mid-June. Fuente: Euronews.

item.description: El canciller alemán, Friedrich Merz, se ha comprometido públicamente a repatriar a «todos los sirios» llegados a Alemania en los próximos tres años y muchos han dudado de que lo consiga, dado que estaríamos hablando de unas 800.000 personas . Finalmente, ha llegado a un acuerdo con los socialdemócratas (SPD), sus socios de gobierno, para facilitar ese objetivo.El Gobierno federal, liderado por la Unión Cristianodemócrata (CDU), ha acordado varias medidas financieras y logísticas para incentivar significativamente la salida voluntaria de los sirios a partir de 2027. item.title: Hong Kong completes ‘historic’ overhaul of colonial-era laws 7 months early
item.description: Authorities have completed the “historic mission” of adapting Hong Kong’s pre-existing laws, removing colonial-era references and outdated provisions seven months ahead of the 30th anniversary of Hong Kong’s return to Chinese sovereignty, with Beijing calling it a symbolic milestone in fulfilling the city’s constitutional obligations. The Department of Justice said on Friday that the government had gazetted the Statute Law (Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance 2026 and subsidiary legislation... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Japan's radical past: Retracing the far-left groups of the 1970s
item.description: Our correspondents delve into the history of Japan's radical left in the 1970s. From the United Red Army to the Japanese Red Army, several movements turned to armed struggle and violent action. More than half a century on, our team met with two former militants. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Indian police said they had rescued 164 foreign nationals allegedly trafficked into the country and forced to commit online fraud, in a rare case involving victims from overseas. Fraud compounds, where international scammers lure internet users into fake romantic relationships, cryptocurrency investments and betting platforms, are common in Southeast Asia. While similar crimes are also widespread in India, it is much less common for the ringleaders to traffic foreigners into the country to... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Ciudadanía por ascendencia: ¿quién puede ser europeo hoy?
item.description: ¿Quién puede ser europeo hoy? La ciudadanía de la Unión Europea se obtiene automáticamente al ser nacional de cualquiera de sus 27 Estados miembros, pero cada país fija sus propias reglas. Durante décadas, miles de latinoamericanos la buscaron por ascendencia en consulados de Caracas, Buenos Aires o Ciudad de México. Hoy esa puerta se cierra: Italia limita la ciudadanía por sangre a hijos y nietos, Portugal y Alemania endurecen sus leyes y la justicia europea tumbó los pasaportes de oro de Malta. Lo analizamos en Ventana a Europa. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Laura Garzón

item.title: Egypt arrests driver accused of causing deadly Cairo fuel tanker crash
item.description: Egyptian authorities have arrested a driver accused of causing a fuel tanker to overturn.The accident on Wednesday on a busy ring road surrounding Cairo caused the death of 31 people and injured 26 others. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Crisis habitacional en España: jóvenes con buenos empleos, pero sin acceso a vivienda
item.description: La crisis de vivienda sigue marcando la vida de miles de personas en España. Cristina gana 1.800 euros al mes, un 50% más que el salario mínimo, pero aún no puede independizarse y continúa viviendo con su familia. Como ella, muchos jóvenes y trabajadores denuncian que acceder a una vivienda digna se ha convertido en un desafío cada vez mayor. Mientras vecinos organizados intentan evitar la venta de sus edificios a fondos de inversión, los sindicatos de inquilinos intensifican su lucha contra los desalojos. Un informe de Elise Gazengel y Maud Watine. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
